boundingBox.title: Area (south, west, north, east)
boundingBox.description: Four numbers in degrees: south, west, north, east. Under 4 square degrees. Example: Bentonville to Fayetteville, Arkansas is [36.03, -94.32, 36.50, -94.05].

trades.title: Trades
trades.description: Any of: plumber, hvac, roofer, electrician, painter, carpenter, landscaper.

onlyWithoutWebsite.title: Only businesses with no website listed
onlyWithoutWebsite.description: Keeps businesses that list no website or only a social page. OpenStreetMap is incomplete, so check before you rely on it.
